scope: Full10M development follow-up of HalfCheetah3x2/6x1 matched BPPO/AR,three development seeds0-2. Exact selected frozen source and optimization settings;32 complete deterministic episodes every500k. All12 outcomes retained. The independent2x3 BPPO confirmation failed; this study expands task coverage and does not repair that result or establish independent confirmation.
area_rule: trapezoidal integral of logged evaluation means over actual training steps, divided by full budget

uncertainty.unit: training-seed mean; evaluation episodes are not independent training seeds
uncertainty.interval: percentile bootstrap, linear percentile interpolation; omitted below five seeds

interpretation: All declared seeds must complete at the same settings and evaluation grid before aggregation. Intervals do not certify independent final seeds, protocol equivalence or paper superiority.
